description: This file manages provider account statuses, including building an index of provider accounts, formatting labels and states, and listing providers for agents based on configuration and bindings.

methods.name: providerAccountKey
methods.description: Generates a unique key for a provider account based on provider ID and account ID.

methods.name: formatChannelAccountLabel
methods.description: Creates a label for a channel account, including provider label and account name.

methods.name: formatProviderState
methods.description: Formats the state of a provider account, including enabled/disabled status.

methods.name: buildProviderStatusIndex
methods.description: Builds an index (Map) of provider account statuses based on configuration and plugins.

methods.name: resolveDefaultAccountId
methods.description: Resolves the default account ID for a given provider.

methods.name: shouldShowProviderEntry
methods.description: Determines if a provider entry should be shown based on configuration.

methods.name: formatProviderEntry
methods.description: Formats a provider account status into a display string.

methods.name: summarizeBindings
methods.description: Summarizes agent bindings into a list of provider labels.

methods.name: listProvidersForAgent
methods.description: Lists provider entries relevant to an agent based on configuration, bindings, and provider status.
